_doc: World stream, round 11 (owner live #48: 'Add 2 new reptile-based mounts available for purchase at the new island'). Vharlen's own mounts, ADDED to the default table (`extends: true`, js/sim/province.js mergeMounts): a mount you own rides on every island, but only Vharlen's stables sell these. Price / level are re-read from economy.json `mounts[]`; a dearer mount is a faster one (tests/A/pt11-ui.test.js, tests/E/round11-world.test.js). Bodies: avatar-3d/js/mount-types.js MOUNT_TYPES `ash_strider` (the drake frame, no wings) and `slag_basker` (the crocodile frame).

mounts.name: Ash Strider
mounts.desc: A long-legged rock lizard bred on the ash roads. Quick on hot ground and not much bothered by anything.

mounts.name: Slag Basker
mounts.desc: A broad, armoured lizard that sleeps on warm slag and walks through anything. Slow to start, very hard to throw.
